repair_subject.message: trigger4: repair WP715 clock and output sequence invariants

fixture_analysis.reason: The positive barge-in fixture asks the reducer to cancel an output whose current admitted state is at monotonic_ms=200 using a barge-in packet at monotonic_ms=100. The repaired causal-clock invariant correctly rejects that rollback.
fixture_analysis.required_test_repair: Set the positive barge-in fixture monotonic_ms to a value >= the current output state timestamp (for example >200) while preserving the intended heard_fraction=0.2 interruption semantics.

next_exact_action: WP715 owner updates only the stale positive barge-in fixture timestamp, reruns run-equivalent repository CI against the exact repaired source, then if green dispatches/executes the already-bound exact-source VPS S1/S2 falsifier. T7 does not mutate WP715-owned source/tests.
